  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import solve
from scipy.sparse import diags, eye, kron
from scipy.sparse.linalg import splu

Axis = tuple[float, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, float, np.ndarray]


def calibrate_affine_banks(raw: np.ndarray, row_banks: np.ndarray, levels: np.ndarray, readings: np.ndarray, sweep_banks: np.ndarray, n_banks: int, *, residual_tol: float, min_current_checks: int | np.ndarray = 3, prior_gain: np.ndarray | None = None, prior_offset: np.ndarray | None = None, level_rtol: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Invert raw = gain * reference + offset independently for each bank.

    Supply residual_tol in raw readout units, based on sweep precision. The
    default minimum of three current checks is for EMI-prone banks; use two
    only for trusted banks or trusted historical sweeps. If the all-check fit
    fails, use positive two-point seeds and retain a strict majority of at
    least three checks, then refit. Relative level resolution defaults to 1e-8
    of the largest absolute bank reference level. There is no gain penalty:
    on failure, keep both caller-supplied coefficients from an eligible
    same-bank prior, or raise if none is available. Returns corrected rows,
    gains, offsets and a boolean mask marking banks fitted on current data.
    Unobserved banks are not fitted and their returned coefficients are NaN.
    """
    raw, x, y = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (raw, levels, readings))
    rows, banks = map(np.asarray, (row_banks, sweep_banks))
    checks = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(min_current_checks), (n_banks,))
    if raw.ndim != 1 or x.ndim != 1 or y.shape != x.shape or rows.shape != raw.shape or banks.shape != x.shape:
        raise ValueError('Expected aligned one-dimensional observations and sweeps')
    if n_banks < 1 or checks.dtype.kind not in 'iu' or np.any(checks < 2):
        raise ValueError('Each bank must require at least two current checks')
    if not np.isfinite(residual_tol) or residual_tol <= 0 or not 0 < level_rtol < 1:
        raise ValueError('Expected positive readout tolerance and relative level resolution in (0, 1)')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (raw, x, y)):
        raise ValueError('Readouts and reference levels must be finite')
    for labels in (rows, banks):
        if labels.dtype.kind not in 'iu' or np.any((labels < 0) | (labels >= n_banks)):
            raise ValueError('Bank labels must be integer indices')
    if (prior_gain is None) != (prior_offset is None):
        raise ValueError('Supply both historical coefficient arrays or neither')
    if prior_gain is not None:
        pg, po = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (prior_gain, prior_offset))
        if pg.shape != (n_banks,) or po.shape != (n_banks,):
            raise ValueError('Historical coefficients must be indexed by bank')
    gain, offset = np.full(n_banks, np.nan), np.full(n_banks, np.nan)
    current = np.zeros(n_banks, dtype=bool)
    for b in np.unique(rows):
        xb, yb = x[banks == b], y[banks == b]
        n = xb.size
        if n >= checks[b]:
            scale = np.max(np.abs(xb))
            if scale > 0:
                u = xb / scale
                if np.ptp(u) > level_rtol:
                    X = np.column_stack((u, np.ones(n)))
                    p = np.linalg.lstsq(X, yb, rcond=None)[0]
                    if p[0] > 0 and np.max(np.abs(X @ p - yb)) <= residual_tol:
                        gain[b], offset[b], current[b] = p[0] / scale, p[1], True
                    else:
                        minimum = max(int(checks[b]), 3, n // 2 + 1)
                        best = (minimum - 1, -np.inf)
                        for i in range(n - 1):
                            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                                dx = u[j] - u[i]
                                if abs(dx) <= level_rtol:
                                    continue
                                slope = (yb[j] - yb[i]) / dx
                                if slope <= 0:
                                    continue
                                r = yb - yb[i] - slope * (u - u[i])
                                keep = np.abs(r) <= residual_tol
                                count = np.count_nonzero(keep)
                                if count < minimum:
                                    continue
                                score = (count, -float(r[keep] @ r[keep]))
                                if score > best:
                                    p = np.linalg.lstsq(X[keep], yb[keep], rcond=None)[0]
                                    if p[0] > 0 and np.max(np.abs(X[keep] @ p - yb[keep])) <= residual_tol:
                                        best = score
                                        gain[b], offset[b], current[b] = p[0] / scale, p[1], True
        if not current[b]:
            if prior_gain is None or not np.isfinite([pg[b], po[b]]).all() or pg[b] <= 0:
                raise ValueError(f'No identifiable calibration for bank {b}')
            gain[b], offset[b] = pg[b], po[b]
    return (raw - offset[rows]) / gain[rows], gain, offset, current


def separable_transport_design(x_axis: Axis, y_axis: Axis, reaction: np.ndarray, source_modes: np.ndarray, shifts: np.ndarray, sensor_indices: np.ndarray, *, separability_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Solve shifted cell-centered transport on a uniform rectangular grid.

    Axis tuples are (length, cell diffusivity, signed cell velocity, Robin
    transfer, base cell reaction) in L, L²/T, L/T, L/T, and 1/T. The 2D map
    and shifts are rates; source_modes has shape (m, nx, ny) in field/T.
    Add the mean-derived profiles to the base reactions, rejecting maps
    outside the relative Frobenius gate. Use nominal diffusivity and no
    forward regularization. Each shift must give a nonsingular system.
    Return a shift-major design and the mode fields at the last input shift.
    Sensor pairs are cell indices, not graph edges; sample only listed cells.
    """
    V, modes, mu = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (reaction, source_modes, shifts))
    ij = np.asarray(sensor_indices)
    if V.ndim != 2 or min(V.shape) < 2 or modes.ndim != 3 or modes.shape[0] == 0 or modes.shape[1:] != V.shape:
        raise ValueError('Expected a rectangular grid with aligned source modes')
    if mu.ndim != 1 or not mu.size or ij.ndim != 2 or ij.shape[1] != 2 or ij.dtype.kind not in 'iu' or np.any((ij < 0) | (ij >= V.shape)):
        raise ValueError('Expected nonempty shifts and valid sensor cell indices')
    if not 0 <= separability_rtol < 1 or not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (V, modes, mu)):
        raise ValueError('Expected finite transport inputs and a relative gate in [0, 1)')
    vx, vy = V.mean(axis=1), V.mean(axis=0) - V.mean()
    if np.linalg.norm(V - vx[:, None] - vy[None, :]) > separability_rtol * np.linalg.norm(V):
        raise ValueError('Reaction exceeds the additive defect gate; use a coupled operator')

    def axis_operator(axis: Axis, addition: np.ndarray) -> object:
        length, diffusivity, velocity, robin, base_reaction = axis
        k, v, q = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (diffusivity, velocity, base_reaction))
        n = addition.size
        if any(a.shape != (n,) or not np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (k, v, q)) or not np.isfinite([length, robin]).all() or length <= 0 or robin < 0 or np.any(k <= 0):
            raise ValueError('Expected positive axis length and diffusivity, and nonnegative Robin transfer')
        h = length / n
        k, v, beta = k / h / h, v / h, robin / h
        small, large = np.minimum(k[:-1], k[1:]), np.maximum(k[:-1], k[1:])
        face = small * (2.0 / (1.0 + small / large))
        diagonal = q + addition + np.abs(v)
        diagonal[:-1] += face
        diagonal[1:] += face
        ends = k[[0, -1]]
        diagonal[[0, -1]] += beta * (ends / (0.5 * beta + ends))
        lower = -face - np.maximum(v[1:], 0.0)
        upper = -face - np.maximum(-v[:-1], 0.0)
        return diags((lower, diagonal, upper), (-1, 0, 1), format='csc')

    nx, ny = V.shape
    ax, ay = axis_operator(x_axis, vx), axis_operator(y_axis, vy)
    base = kron(ax, eye(ny), format='csc') + kron(eye(nx), ay, format='csc')
    identity = eye(nx * ny, format='csc')
    rhs = modes.reshape(modes.shape[0], nx * ny).T
    ij = ij.astype(np.intp, copy=False)
    rows = ij[:, 0] * ny + ij[:, 1]
    blocks = []
    for shift in mu:
        fields = splu(base + shift * identity).solve(rhs)
        blocks.append(fields[rows])
    return np.concatenate(blocks, axis=0), fields.T.reshape(modes.shape)


def invert_box_simplex(design: np.ndarray, observations: np.ndarray, cap: float, budget: float, *, nuisance: np.ndarray | None = None, nuisance_ridge: float = 1e-8, source_ridge: float = 1e-8, tol: float = 1e-11) -> tuple[np.ndarray, dict[str, float | np.ndarray]]:
    """Fit weights 0 <= w <= cap with sum(w) = budget.

    Minimize 0.5*||R(Sw-y)||² + 0.5*source_ridge*||w||², where R is the
    ridge residual maker for the optional row-aligned nuisance matrix.
    This uses R.T @ R, not the jointly profiled ridge loss. Both ridge
    defaults (1e-8) assume scaled inputs; choose matching penalties for
    dimensional data. The active-set tolerance is dimensionless. Return
    weights and a tangent lower bound with reduced gradient g - nu_sum.
    """
    S, y = (np.asarray(a, dtype=float) for a in (design, observations))
    if S.ndim != 2 or y.shape != (S.shape[0],) or not S.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError('Expected a row-aligned design and observation vector')
    m = S.shape[1]
    if not np.isfinite([cap, budget, source_ridge, nuisance_ridge, tol]).all() or not np.isfinite(S).all() or not np.isfinite(y).all() or cap < 0 or not 0 <= budget <= m * cap or min(source_ridge, nuisance_ridge, tol) <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Expected finite data, a feasible box simplex and positive penalties')
    if nuisance is not None:
        Z = np.asarray(nuisance, dtype=float)
        if Z.ndim != 2 or Z.shape[0] != y.size or not np.isfinite(Z).all():
            raise ValueError('Nuisance columns must be finite and observation-aligned')
        if Z.shape[1]:
            data = np.column_stack((S, y))
            gram = Z.T @ Z + nuisance_ridge * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            data -= Z @ solve(gram, Z.T @ data, assume_a='pos')
            S, y = data[:, :-1], data[:, -1]
    H = S.T @ S + source_ridge * np.eye(m)
    c = -(S.T @ y)
    if budget == 0:
        w, nu = np.zeros(m), float(np.min(c))
    elif budget == m * cap:
        w = np.full(m, cap)
        nu = float(np.max(H @ w + c))
    else:
        scale = max(cap * np.max(np.abs(H)), np.max(np.abs(c)))
        G, d = (cap / scale) * H, c / scale
        mass = budget / cap
        u = np.full(m, mass / m)
        active = np.zeros(m, dtype=int)
        for _ in range(20 * m * m):
            g = G @ u + d
            free = np.flatnonzero(active == 0)
            if not free.size:
                lo, hi = np.flatnonzero(active < 0), np.flatnonzero(active > 0)
                i, j = lo[np.argmin(g[lo])], hi[np.argmax(g[hi])]
                if g[j] - g[i] <= tol:
                    nu_scaled = 0.5 * (g[i] + g[j])
                    break
                active[[i, j]] = 0
                continue
            K = np.zeros((free.size + 1, free.size + 1))
            K[:-1, :-1] = G[np.ix_(free, free)]
            K[:-1, -1] = K[-1, :-1] = -1.0
            step = solve(K, np.r_[-g[free], u.sum() - mass], assume_a='sym')
            move, nu_scaled = step[:-1], step[-1]
            hit = np.full(free.size, np.inf)
            up, down = move > 0, move < 0
            hit[up] = (1.0 - u[free[up]]) / move[up]
            hit[down] = -u[free[down]] / move[down]
            k = int(np.argmin(hit))
            if hit[k] < 1.0:
                u[free] += max(0.0, hit[k]) * move
                active[free[k]] = 1 if up[k] else -1
                u[free[k]] = float(up[k])
                continue
            u[free] += move
            violation = active * (G @ u + d - nu_scaled)
            k = int(np.argmax(violation))
            if violation[k] <= tol:
                break
            active[k] = 0
        else:
            raise RuntimeError('Box-simplex active set did not converge')
        w, nu = cap * np.clip(u, 0.0, 1.0), float(scale * nu_scaled)
    r = S @ w - y
    g = S.T @ r + source_ridge * w
    objective = 0.5 * float(r @ r + source_ridge * (w @ w))
    lower, upper = np.maximum(g - nu, 0), np.maximum(nu - g, 0)
    bound = objective + nu * (budget - w.sum()) - lower @ w - upper @ (cap - w)
    return w, {'nu_sum': nu, 'lam_lower': lower, 'lam_upper': upper,
               'primal_objective': objective, 'dual_lower_bound': float(bound)}
",
  "synthetic_unit_test_code": "def run_self_test():
    import numpy as np
    from numpy.testing import assert_allclose, assert_array_equal, assert_raises

    # One clean majority, one misleading two-point line, one inconsistent
    # three-point bank, and one independently trusted two-point bank.
    bank = np.repeat(np.arange(4), [5, 2, 3, 2])
    levels = np.array([-2., -1., 0., 1., 2., 0., 1., 0., 1., 2., 0., 1.])
    g = np.array([1.4, 0.7, 1.3, 0.8])
    b = np.array([-0.12, 0.3, -0.2, 0.17])
    checks = g[bank] * levels + b[bank]
    checks[[2, 6, 8]] += [25., 4., 8.]
    rows = np.array([3, 0, 2, 1, 0])
    clean = np.array([-0.4, 0.5, 1.2, -0.8, 0.3])
    raw = g[rows] * clean + b[rows]
    for factor in (1., 0.01):
        y, gains, offsets, current = calibrate_affine_banks(
            factor * raw, rows, levels, factor * checks, bank, 4,
            residual_tol=factor * 3e-6, min_current_checks=[3, 3, 3, 2],
            prior_gain=factor * g, prior_offset=factor * b)
        assert_allclose(y, clean, atol=1e-12)
        assert_allclose(gains, factor * g, atol=1e-12)
        assert_allclose(offsets, factor * b, atol=1e-12)
        assert_array_equal(current, [True, False, False, True])
    with assert_raises(ValueError):
        calibrate_affine_banks(raw, rows, levels, checks, bank, 4,
                               residual_tol=3e-6, min_current_checks=[3, 3, 3, 2])

    xa = (2., np.array([1., 3.]), np.array([-2., 1.]), 2., np.array([0.2, 0.4]))
    ya = (1., np.array([0.5, 0.5]), np.zeros(2), 0., np.array([0.1, 0.3]))
    V = np.array([[0.3, 0.5], [0.7, 0.9]])
    modes = np.array([[[1., 0.], [0.2, 0.4]], [[0., 0.7], [0.5, 0.1]]])
    shifts = np.array([0.4, 1.1])
    cells = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 0], [1, 1], [0, 1]])
    S, terminal = separable_transport_design(xa, ya, V, modes, shifts, cells)
    # Independently assembled two-cell stencils, including both reactions.
    A = np.array([[5.1, -3.5], [-2.5, 5.2]])
    B = np.array([[2.0, -2.0], [-2.0, 2.4]])
    dense = np.kron(A, np.eye(2)) + np.kron(np.eye(2), B)
    expected = [np.linalg.solve(dense + mu * np.eye(4), modes.reshape(2, 4).T)
                .T.reshape(modes.shape) for mu in shifts]
    assert_allclose(S, np.concatenate([U[:, cells[:, 0], cells[:, 1]].T for U in expected]), atol=1e-13)
    assert_allclose(terminal, expected[-1], atol=1e-13)

    def scaled(axis, l, t):
        L, k, v, robin, q = axis
        return l * L, l**2 * k / t, l * v / t, l * robin / t, q / t

    # The steady shifted PDE has no carrier; halve its time scale to double
    # all rates. The observation list includes only i < j, with no reverse.
    upper = cells[:, 0] < cells[:, 1]
    for l, t in ((1., 1.), (0.01, 1.), (1., 0.5), (0.01, 0.5)):
        S2, U2 = separable_transport_design(scaled(xa, l, t), scaled(ya, l, t),
                                            V / t, modes / t, shifts / t, cells[upper])
        assert_allclose(S2, S[np.tile(upper, shifts.size)], atol=1e-13)
        assert_allclose(U2, terminal, atol=1e-13)
    Sg, Ug = separable_transport_design((*xa[:4], xa[4] + 0.25),
                                       (*ya[:4], ya[4] - 0.25), V, modes, shifts, cells)
    assert_allclose(Sg, S, atol=1e-13)
    assert_allclose(Ug, terminal, atol=1e-13)
    with assert_raises(ValueError):
        separable_transport_design(xa, ya, V + np.diag([0.1, 0.]), modes, shifts, cells)

    # A nuisance column acts on a free coordinate, distinguishing R.T @ R
    # from R. Independent KKT solution: two free and two bound coordinates.
    w, cert = invert_box_simplex(np.eye(4), [-0.3, 0.2, 0.5, 2.], 0.6, 1.2,
                                 nuisance=[[0.], [1.], [0.], [0.]],
                                 nuisance_ridge=1., source_ridge=0.5)
    assert_allclose(w, [0., 0.2, 0.4, 0.6], atol=1e-10)
    assert_allclose(w.sum(), 1.2, atol=1e-12)
    assert_allclose(cert['nu_sum'], 0.1, atol=1e-10)
    assert_allclose(cert['lam_lower'], [0.2, 0., 0., 0.], atol=1e-10)
    assert_allclose(cert['lam_upper'], [0., 0., 0., 1.2], atol=1e-10)
    assert abs(cert['primal_objective'] - cert['dual_lower_bound']) < 1e-10

    # Construct data whose exact regularized minimizer is the chosen mixture.
    truth = np.array([0.25, 0.75])
    ridge = 1e-6
    data = S @ truth + ridge * (S @ np.linalg.solve(S.T @ S, truth))
    fitted, field_cert = invert_box_simplex(S, data, 0.9, 1., source_ridge=ridge)
    field = np.einsum('m,mij->ij', fitted, terminal)
    assert_allclose(fitted, truth, atol=1e-10)
    assert_allclose(field, np.einsum('m,mij->ij', truth, expected[-1]), atol=1e-10)
    assert abs(field_cert['primal_objective'] - field_cert['dual_lower_bound']) < 1e-10
    for a in (y, gains, offsets, S, terminal, S2, U2, w, fitted, field, *cert.values(), *field_cert.values()):
        assert np.isfinite(a).all()


run_self_test()
